about: Drafting specs for each supported document. `filename` links to catalog.json and templates/. Every field is free text; kind 'date' fields hold yyyy-mm-dd and 'long' fields are multi-line. Each document also has two parties with company, signatory name, title and notice address.

documents.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.intro: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “MNDA”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“Cover Page”) and (2) the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms Version 1.0 (“Standard Terms”) identical to those posted at commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/1.0. Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
documents.signingStatement: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this MNDA as of the Effective Date.

fields.description: The length of this MNDA: 'Expires N year(s) from Effective Date.' or 'Continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA.'

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected: 'N year(s) from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.' or 'In perpetuity.'
fields.default: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.
